name: lyne-restaurant
description: LYNE RESTAURANT — Système interne de gestion de restaurant (monorepo).

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:ui && npm run build:api && npm run build:admin-web && npm run typecheck:mobile
scripts.build:api: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace lyne-api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run build:ui && npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck:shared && npm run typecheck:ui && npm run typecheck:api && npm run typecheck:admin-web && npm run typecheck:mobile
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run db:generate && npm run dev --workspace lyne-api
scripts.dev:admin-web: npm run build:shared && npm run build:ui && npm run dev --workspace lyne-admin-web
scripts.dev:mobile: npm run build:shared && npm run start --workspace lyne-mobile
scripts.db:deploy: npm run db:check-history && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --env-file-if-exists=services/api/.env node_modules/prisma/build/index.js migrate deploy --config database/prisma.config.ts
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run db:generate && vitest run
